description:
Validate vault files against the schemas directory.

Usage: [PATHS...] [--schemas DIR] [--quiet]

Args:
  PATHS — zero or more files to validate; with none, walks the whole vault

Flags:
  --schemas DIR — schemas directory; defaults to the schemas directory shipped with the installation
  --quiet — suppress per-violation output, leaving only the exit code

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]
  ["notes/2026-06-01-14-30-00.md"]

Notes:
  Violations print as path:line: message.
  Exit 0 clean, 1 if any violations, 2 on a usage or setup failure.
  Run after any batch of mutations and before `commit save`.
